title: Noke sina pe kehta
body:
noke sina pe kehta tha ye sar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon ka noor qalb ki taakhat chali gayi
ghode se jab gira ali akbar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
noke sina pe kehta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ne apne haath rakhe taygh ke talay
sar kaatne laga jo sitamgar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
noke sina pe kehta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye imtehan esabr tha warna ay shamiyon
bhaari tha poori fauj pe asghar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
noke sina pe kehta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch boodhe kuch jawan thay aur ek sheerkhaar
laakhon ke saamne tha ye lashkar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
noke sina pe kehta tha...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan mujhko dekh kar jannat pukaar uthi
aane do aa raha hai ye naukar hussain ka
kya kar saka layeen tera khanjar hussain ka
noke sina pe kehta tha...
author: Rehaan Azmi
